examples.english: We burst out laughing.
examples.persian: ناگهان زدیم زیر خنده.

miniContext: There are noises I love - when someone bursts out laughing, or people cheer at football matches.

examples.english: Most people stood up and cheered when Liam won.
examples.persian: وقتی لیام برنده شد، بیشتر مردم بلند شدند و هورا کشیدند.

miniContext: Most people stood up and cheered when Liam won, but a couple booed.

examples.english: The poor man can't hear a thing: he's been deaf for years.
examples.persian: آن مرد بیچاره چیزی نمی‌شنود: سال‌هاست ناشنواست.

miniContext: The poor man can't hear a thing: he's been deaf for years.

examples.english: There was a lot of background noise.
examples.persian: سروصدای پس‌زمینه زیادی بود.

miniContext: Background noise of cars, machines, etc. can be so irritating.

examples.english: A lot of young people talk very quickly and not very clearly. It's very irritating.
examples.persian: خیلی از جوان‌ها خیلی سریع و نامفهوم حرف می‌زنند. خیلی آزاردهنده است.

miniContext: Background noise of cars, machines, etc. that can be so irritating.

examples.english: The poor boy was in tears.
examples.persian: آن پسر بیچاره داشت گریه می‌کرد.

miniContext: The sound of a child in tears.

examples.english: If you spend time with someone with a cold, you might catch their cold.
examples.persian: اگر با کسی که سرما خورده وقت بگذرانی، ممکن است سرما بخوری.

miniContext: The sound of someone sneezing makes me worry I will be the next person to catch their cold.

examples.english: Please stop whispering like that.
examples.persian: لطفاً این‌طور زمزمه نکن.

miniContext: Someone whispering behind me - I imagine they are talking about me!

examples.english: I overheard two people on the bus talking about unpleasant noises.
examples.persian: ناخواسته شنیدم که دو نفر در اتوبوس درباره صداهای ناخوشایند صحبت می‌کردند.

miniContext: Overhearing something unpleasant that I wasn't meant to hear.

examples.english: When my mother sighs like that, I can tell she's disappointed.
examples.persian: وقتی مادرم این‌طور آه می‌کشد، می‌فهمم که ناامید شده.

miniContext: When my mother sighs like that, I can tell she's disappointed.

examples.english: Most people cheered when Liam won, but a couple booed.
examples.persian: بیشتر مردم وقتی لیام برنده شد هورا کشیدند، اما چند نفری هو کردند.

miniContext: People booing at sports events or other occasions - it's very rude.

examples.english: My husband snores in his sleep.
examples.persian: شوهرم هنگام خواب خروپف می‌کند.

miniContext: My partner snores! One or two people have told me I snore in my sleep.

examples.english: I could hear a car horn in the distance.
examples.persian: از دور صدای بوق ماشین را می‌شنیدم.

miniContext: I could hear a car horn in the distance.

examples.english: Several dogs were barking.
examples.persian: چند سگ پارس می‌کردند.

miniContext: Several dogs were barking.

examples.english: I heard a crash.
examples.persian: صدای برخورد شدیدی شنیدم.

miniContext: I heard a crash.

examples.english: Someone yelled.
examples.persian: یک نفر داد زد.

miniContext: I opened the door and someone started shouting really loudly.

examples.english: A car door slammed.
examples.persian: در ماشین محکم بسته شد.

miniContext: A car door slammed.

examples.english: Something hit my window - it cracked.
examples.persian: چیزی به پنجره‌ام خورد و آن ترک برداشت.

miniContext: Something hit my window - it cracked.

examples.english: I heard footsteps in the hall.
examples.persian: صدای قدم‌هایی در راهرو شنیدم.

miniContext: I heard footsteps in the hall.

examples.english: Silence. Then my door handle turned.
examples.persian: سکوت. بعد دستگیره در من چرخید.

miniContext: Silence. Then my door handle turned.

examples.english: I screamed and woke up.
examples.persian: جیغ کشیدم و از خواب بیدار شدم.

miniContext: I screamed and woke up.

examples.english: It was a nightmare. I breathed a sigh of relief.
examples.persian: یک کابوس بود. نفس راحتی کشیدم.

miniContext: It was a nightmare. I breathed a sigh of relief.

examples.english: My trip to London was a nightmare: all the trains were delayed.
examples.persian: سفرم به لندن یک کابوس بود: همه قطارها تاخیر داشتند.

miniContext: My trip to London was a nightmare: all the trains were delayed.
